stemMd: An element has two isotopes of approximate masses 10 and 11 units, present at 20% and 80%. What is its approximate relative atomic mass?
explanationMd: Compute the weighted mean: 0.20 times 10 plus 0.80 times 11 equals 2 plus 8.8, or 10.8. It should lie nearer the more abundant isotope's mass.

distractorRationale.a: This omits the lighter isotope contribution.
